hero.title: See what the universe has bloomed for you.
hero.description: Gingermite is a luxury flower shop located in Central Hong Kong, known for tailor-made bouquets and artistic floral creations. Inspired by fine art and storytelling, we offer flower delivery, workshops, and event styling for luxury brands and individuals. Every arrangement is a poetic expression made with the finest blooms.
